podcast.title: Judgment Night Soundtrack as Catalyst (1993)
podcast.body: The 1993 *Judgment Night* soundtrack, which radically paired rock bands with hip-hop outfits for 11 collaborations, was a major catalyst for the creation of rap rock. This groundbreaking project helped bridge the divide between rock and hip-hop worlds, bringing fans from both sides into new genres that would become very big later in the decade. "In retrospect, this was a major catalyst for the creation of rap rock and new metal, two genres that would be very, very big later in the decade."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influence on Industrial Hip Hop Momentum
podcast.body: Rap rock, as exemplified by bands like Rage Against the Machine and Beastie Boys, was a key factor in Industrial Hip Hop gaining momentum in the 1990s. "Think Rage Against the Machine, Ice Teas Body Counts, and Beastie Boy songs like Sabotage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Roots of Death Grips' Sound
podcast.body: The American trio Death Grips rooted some of their ideas in rap rock, but expanded their sound to encompass much more within the Alternative Rap genre. "The fifth grips is an American trio who missed around with all kinds of different ideas rooted in rap rock, but encompassed much more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
